About the Department
About the Department (Max. 500 words): About the Department  The Department of English was established in 2020. The Department offers honours in English and also facilitates the growth and development of the students’ creative faculty through its platform “Euphoria: Forum for English Studies”. The Department aims to ensure an all round development by encouraging effective communication between teachers and students. Currently the Department is functioning with four faculty members.
